styleSelection.reason: The sheet is a loose watercolor already: broad value planes, soft lost edges, and a few deep pigment accents carry the ship forms. The requested treatment is pure watercolor with no drawn line layer.

families.referenceCue: The large cool blue-grey vessel curves from the upper left through the centre to its dark lower hull; keep one broad turning plane and an irregular soft edge.
Pale sail and open paper shapes overlap behind the blue vessel; retain their near-paper value and let selected edges disappear into the sheet.
A cropped darker vessel and a few warm ochre spars cross at the left; use broken connected washes, with depth concentrated at the overlap.
The lower-right water is a soft turquoise field with a few broken pale glints and cool reflection shapes; no repeated horizontal strips.

reserves.reason: Bare-paper fleck in the cool hull sheen; keep it out of every wash.
Small paper glint at the pale sail edge; the surrounding sail remains a pale painted plane.
Broken bare-paper reflection in the turquoise water.
